scope: Logical evidence dependencies and occurrence accounting. No trusted event logger, motion controller or acoustic backend is implemented.

scopes.job: Each finite fabrication job identified by the qualified part manifest
scopes.microphone: Separate calibration load, acquisition and release for each of two physical microphones
scopes.condition: Separate source isolation, panel state, start, closure and reference-stability evidence for each condition
scopes.point: Each of 190 registered positions within each condition
scopes.readout: Every selected or failed raw-readout attempt
scopes.part_route: Printer, finishing, inspection and assembly transfers

receipt_semantics: Synthetic accepted receipts establish only bookkeeping for tests. Production receipt status must come from independently authenticated event infrastructure.
limits: No reachability, payload support, acoustic boundary condition or collision is validated
Qualified cards in test fixtures are explicit synthetic placeholders; test passing does not resolve any of the seventeen execution gates
Exact occurrence ancestry is checked, but sensor truth and measurement uncertainty require a future trusted implementation
branch_scope: One paired campaign with all declared fabrication and setup prerequisites, both condition episodes and final cleanup. Numerical branches are not executed.

location_aware_cleanup.final_condition_with: Support and remove installed panel, inspect, retain and return
location_aware_cleanup.final_condition_without: Verify panel already retained, inspect and return without reinstalling
